items.name: vois-tokens
items.title: Vois tokens
items.description: Default values for every Vois token, generated from the Vois Figma variables, with a generic blue brand, plus the motion tokens and the shape roles in their own files. Use it when the Vois MCP isn't serving your workspace's live values.

items.name: vois-theme
items.title: Vois theme
items.description: Points every shadcn/ui variable at its Vois token (vois-tokens DS-TOKEN-005). Ships no color values. Import it after Tailwind.

items.name: vois-spinner
items.title: Vois Spinner
items.description: One open arc turning in a circle (the loading.dev arc, MIT), timed by --motion-duration-spin, still under reduced motion, currentColor, sizes 16/20/24. The Button's loading state uses it.

items.name: vois-button
items.title: Vois Button
items.description: shadcn/ui's Button on Vois tokens: the same variant and size names, heights 28/36/48 (36 is the web default, 48 the native default) and 56 circular, a centered label with 4px sides, leading and trailing icons, a loading state with the Vois spinner, the Vois focus ring and hit area, and a pointer-only press scale timed by the motion tokens. Install vois-spinner with it.

items.name: vois-input
items.title: Vois Input
items.description: shadcn/ui's Input on Vois tokens: 36 (web default), 48 (native) and 32 (compact, inline in tables), with the Figma Input Field states (hover, 2px focus, error via aria-invalid, disabled, read-only, prefill).

items.name: vois-select
items.title: Vois Select
items.description: shadcn/ui's Select (Radix) on Vois tokens: a trigger with the Vois Input heights and states, and a list built like the Figma Dropdown Menu and Menu Item. Install vois-input with it: the trigger imports its field classes.

items.name: vois-checkbox
items.title: Vois Checkbox
items.description: shadcn/ui's Checkbox (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Checkbox set: a 24 box with a 2px inside border, checked and indeterminate marks, disabled, the --control-focus ring, an aux variant for strong backgrounds, and a 44 hit area.

items.name: vois-switch
items.title: Vois Switch
items.description: shadcn/ui's Switch (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Web and iOS Switch sets: 32 x 20 on web and 52 x 32 native, a knob that slides in --motion-duration-fast (still under reduced motion), disabled, the --border-state-focus ring and a 44 hit area. For a setting that takes effect at once.

items.name: vois-radio-group
items.title: Vois Radio Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's RadioGroup (Radix) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Radio set: a 22 circle with a 3px --control-border ring that grows to an 8px --control-on ring when selected (a 6px hole), disabled, an aux variant, the --border-state-focus ring, arrow keys with one tab stop, and a 44 hit area.

items.name: vois-tabs
items.title: Vois Tabs
items.description: shadcn/ui's Tabs (Radix) on Vois tokens, in two styles from Figma: pill (the default, the Tab set: 28 or 40 tall, --tab-* fills) and underline (the Tab Nav set: 48 tall, a 2px --border-accent edge when active). Disabled wins over active, and arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: vois-textarea
items.title: Vois Textarea
items.description: shadcn/ui's Textarea on Vois tokens: the Vois Input's box and states, growing with its content (field-sizing: content) from 3 to 12 lines and then scrolling, with a rows and resize fallback for older browsers. Install vois-input with it: it imports the Input's field classes.

items.name: vois-field
items.title: Vois Field
items.description: shadcn/ui's Field parts on Vois tokens, with the Figma Input Label text styles, a required asterisk and FieldControl, which wires the control's id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid and aria-required. The error is announced with role="alert".

items.name: vois-avatar
items.title: Vois Avatar
items.description: shadcn/ui's Avatar (Radix) on Vois tokens: a circle at the --size-avatar-* sizes (24/28/40/56/72, 40 by default) with a ring that keeps stacked avatars apart, initials in the Figma type for each size, and initials, generic and invite fallbacks that show while the image loads or when it fails.

items.name: vois-badge
items.title: Vois Badge
items.description: shadcn/ui's Badge on Vois tokens, from the Figma Labels and Status Labels: solid, soft and outline in the 16 label hues and the status colors (info, positive, warning, negative, neutral, accent, aux), sizes 20 and 24, a pill shape, and states when it is a link or button. shadcn's default, secondary, destructive and outline names still work.

items.name: vois-tooltip
items.title: Vois Tooltip
items.description: shadcn/ui's Tooltip (Radix) on Vois tokens: the Figma Tooltip's dark surface and 12px text on the --z-overlay layer, opening on hover and keyboard focus, kept inside the viewport, with a short fade timed by the motion tokens and none under reduced motion.

items.name: vois-input-group
items.title: Vois Input Group
items.description: shadcn/ui's InputGroup on Vois tokens: the Vois Input's box and heights with icons, text, a prefix or a button inside, from the Figma Search, Email, Password, URL and Input Field with Button sets. The box shows the inner input's focus, error, disabled and prefill states via :has(). Install vois-input with it: the group imports its field classes.

items.name: vois-segmented-control
items.title: Vois Segmented Control
items.description: shadcn/ui's ToggleGroup parts (Radix, type single) on Vois tokens, from the Figma Segments set: a 32 tall --segment-inactive track with --shape-subtle ends, a 28 tall --segment-active indicator with a --border-default edge and --shadow-base, focus, disabled, arrow keys with one tab stop, and no way back to no selection once a choice is made.

items.name: vois-stepper
items.title: Vois Stepper
items.description: The step-progress Stepper from vois-components references/stepper.md (shadcn/ui has none): a nav with an ordered list, 32 markers from the Figma Stepper Dots set for upcoming, current (aria-current="step"), complete and error, 2px connectors from the Stepper Line set, horizontal or vertical, a "Step 2 of 3" line below sm, and optional clickable complete steps.

items.name: vois-choice-list
items.title: Vois Choice List
items.description: Full-width choice rows from the Figma Radio Select and Checkbox Select sets: a 56 row with the radio or checkbox on the left, a 16/24 label and an optional 12/16 description, resting, hover, pressed, active (--select-soft-active with a 2px --border-accent edge), negative, disabled and aux states. ChoiceRadioGroup (one choice, Radix RadioGroup) and ChoiceCheckboxGroup (a value array) share one row style, and the whole row is the click target. Needs vois-radio-group and vois-checkbox.

items.name: vois-choice-card
items.title: Vois Choice Card
items.description: Choice cards from the Figma Radio Card and Checkbox Card sets: --bg-card, --radius-selectors, a 16/24 semibold label, a 14/20 description and an optional body, the radio or checkbox on the right, with resting, hover, active (2px --border-state-active) and focus (2px --border-state-focus) edges. Uses the ChoiceRadioGroup and ChoiceCheckboxGroup groups from vois-choice-list, and the whole card is the click target.

items.name: vois-card
items.title: Vois Card
items.description: shadcn/ui's Card on Vois tokens, from the Figma Card set: the container parts plus an interactive card whose whole surface is one link or button (CardLink), with hover, pressed, focus and disabled looks.

items.name: vois-hover-card
items.title: Vois Hover Card
items.description: shadcn/ui's HoverCard (Radix) on the Figma Popover surface: Bg-Card with a border, a tail, 320 wide, on the overlay layer, kept inside the viewport, with a motion-token fade.

items.name: vois-panel
items.title: Vois Panel
items.description: A persistent secondary pane (inspector, properties) from the Figma Panel set: the push-panel widths 280, 320 or 400, one inner edge, header, scrolling content and footer.
